entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Android] Bottom insets issues when keyboard is shown. #32871
  • Image control crashes on Android when image width exceeds height #32869
  • Shell Flyout Icon is always black #32867
    .NET 10 Servicing

Closed

  • [Android] App rejected while using the MediaPicker in the google playstore #32866
  • XamlC cannot resolve types from external libraries with HTTP-based xmlns in class libraries #32830
  • [iOS] ScrollView Orientation set to Horizontal allows both horizontal and vertical scrolling . #30070
  • Make sure we can revert to default inflator per file #32644
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • SourceGen="false" #32640
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Enable XAML Source Generation (SourceGen) by default in all templates #32732
    .NET 10.0 SR2

PullRequests

Created

  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix alert dialogs not displaying after dismissing modal page on iOS #32872
    community ✨
  • Fix XAML SourceGenerator reusing modified node tree #32870
  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 32841 - [12/01/2025] Candidate #32868
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Rapid change of selected tab results in crash on Windows #32865
    platform/windows, area-controls-tabbedpage, partner/syncfusion
  • [Windows]Fixed the MauiImage with logical name containing path issue #32864
    platform/windows, area-image, partner/syncfusion

Merged

    area-testing

    platform/android, area-testing, testing-flakiness, testing-reenable, testing-green-ci, .NET 10.0 SR2

    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-slider, .NET 10.0 SR2

  • Fix MediaPicker failing after temporary ComponentActivity is opened #32854
    community ✨

    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Enable XAML SourceGen by default in templates and add per-file default support #32733
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2

Updated

  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix Shell navigation bar space incorrectly reserved after back navigation on iOS #32700
    platform/ios, area-controls-shell, community ✨

  • Fix Android/iOS map polygon clearing issue by resetting MapElementId #30116
    platform/android, platform/ios, area-controls-map
